audience: field service companies that run jobs, schedules and invoices in GorillaDesk

useCases.title: Check the schedule and open jobs
useCases.text: List the schedules and the jobs of a customer, then read one job with its schedules.

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices
useCases.text: List invoices by status and date, then open one invoice with its items. Also list the payments received.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their locations
useCases.text: Find a customer by status or account number, then read the customer with its locations and contacts.

useCases.title: Add a new customer with a location
useCases.text: Create a customer with its first service location. Each call creates a new record, so do not repeat it.

useCases.title: Add a note to a customer record
useCases.text: Read the customer, then add a note to the record. Each call creates a new note.

useCases.title: Review technician time entries
useCases.text: List the clock-in and clock-out entries of technicians, by user or by clock-in time.
